title: Ape Lucky Coin
tagline: Luck and Support is what we're all seeking during this challenging crypto winter 🍀
description:
The Ape Lucky Coin is an innovative tool designed to enhance the engagement and interaction within the Ape Coin community while giving participants a chance to realize their dreams. This project revolves around a website that leverages the Ape Coin cryptocurrency and NFT technology to create an exciting and rewarding experience for users. Here's a detailed breakdown of the project:

Ape Lucky Coin NFT:
Users can purchase the NFT called "Ape Lucky Coin" for a fixed price of 1 Ape Coin. This NFT serves as their entry ticket to participate in the "dream lottery".

Dream Submission:
Once users acquire the Ape Lucky Coin NFT, they gain access to a platform where they can submit their dreams. Dreams can be anything that the user aspires to achieve.

Weekly Dream Draw:
Every week, the platform collects all the Ape Lucky Coin purchases made by users during that week. At the end of the week, there is a random drawing to select one lucky user from among those who have submitted their dreams. The selected user is awarded 70% of the total Ape Coins collected during that week.

Developer Support:
30% of the Ape Coins collected during the week are allocated to support the developers and maintain the website, ensuring its ongoing functionality and improvements.

Transparency and Fairness:
Smart contracts or blockchain technology may be employed to guarantee the integrity of the lottery.

Community Engagement:
The project fosters community engagement by encouraging users to share their dreams, creating a sense of belonging and collaboration within the Ape Coin community.

Dream Archive:
The platform maintains an archive of past dreams and winners, allowing users to track the impact of the lottery within the community.

By creating the Ape Coin Community Dream Lottery, the project aims to promote Ape Coin adoption, community participation, and provide a unique opportunity for users to realize their dreams, all while contributing to the sustainability of the platform through developer support. The project's transparency and fairness mechanisms are intended to build trust and strengthen the Ape Coin community.
how_its_made: We've used frontend tools to interact with ape coin ERC20 api and backend for rendering unique lucky coins as nfts which will be available for purchase. We've used react and web3.js on frontend and rainbow wallet to speedup onboarding. Also Uniswap deeplinks to enchance user experience when getting Ape Coin on polygon.
